description: Use this after mapping pages from a repository or documentation and the user wants to add them as unpublished candidates, up to 100 per call. Each page needs a canonical query-free https address on the product's domain, visible proof text, and a description. Re-importing changed fields corrects the candidate and holds it for approval again. This never publishes a page.

note.description: Where the map came from, for example "Next.js routes and Playwright specs".

expect.description: Text a visitor can see on that page, 3 to 120 characters, copied from the UI (a heading or label). Proves the page loaded.

keywords.description: Words a visitor might use to ask for this page.

path.description: Only when the page has no direct address: what to open first, for example ["Settings", "Integrations"].

say.description: One or two sentences on what the page lets a customer do, taken from the product's copy or docs. The guide narrates from this.

signedIn.description: True when the page needs a signed-in account (in-app pages).

title.description: What the page is, in the product's own words, for example "Invoices" or "Slack integration".

url.description: The canonical https address of the page on the running product or website, without a query string, fragment, credentials, or secret-bearing parameters.

name: demopage_import_pages
title: Import candidate demo pages
